verdict.rationale: Rive's editor/design platform is a hosted, proprietary SaaS product; only the rendering runtime is open-sourced (MIT), not the full design platform, and there is no evidence of a self-hosted deployment option for the editor itself. Community commentary explicitly confirms this split — the OSS license covers only 'a subset of the Rive runtime that requires the Rive Editor to build content for' (rive-comm-5), and no docs or GitHub evidence describe self-hosting the editor/platform.
